card.name: Spanish word endings and mid-sentence points
card.fires_on: Spanish text, on the ending of a partly spelled word (nevada, fronterizo, recobran) or on a comma or period after a clause. It is most often seen in Spanish prose and Spanish label text.

modes.label: Spanish word endings
modes.description: Final or middle piece of a Spanish word, such as a verb or adjective ending.
modes.example: fronter<<izo>> que genera una sombra en

modes.label: Punctuation or adverb in Spanish clauses
modes.description: A period, comma or adverb that closes a Spanish clause, including in Spanish label instructions.
modes.example: Agite 10 veces antes de usarlo<<.>> Aplique directamente bajo la leng

card.writes: It pushes toward 'so' and 'pie' and away from 'su'-starting tokens, which is a weak and unclear effect.
card.plain: It fires inside Spanish text, on word endings and clause breaks, and not on any one topic.
